style.styleTitle: The White Company Set of 4 Christmas Optic Drop Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: Delicate, sparkling design. Handmade from mouth-blown glass. Comes with a velvet ribbon. Style with other glass decorations for a frost-tipped theme. The design of these drop-shape baubles adds traditional elegance to festive settings. Each one is handmade, mouth-blown by glassmakers and has an optic design that catches the light beautifully when it spins. Hung from a velvet ribbon and with a glass hook that’s part of the bauble, they’re great for styling in multiples on the tree or layering into elegant tablescapes.
